ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Ambika Cotton Mills Limited's Annual General Meeting notice for FY 2025-26 reveals the company's robust financial health, proposing the adoption of audited statements and a significant final dividend of Rs. 37 per equity share. A key takeaway and potential area for scrutiny is the proposed re-appointment of the 77-year-old Managing Director for another five years, alongside the continued tenure or appointment of three other directors aged 75 or above, all requiring special resolutions under SEBI regulations. This concentration of older leadership, while ensuring continuity, highlights potential governance considerations regarding board rejuvenation and succession planning.
